rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 16 OF "THE EDUCATION ACT OF 1982" BY REQUIRING APPLICANTS TO SECURE A LICENSE FOR A TEACHING POSITION IN PUBLIC AND PRIVATE EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS WHETHER IN THE FORMAL OR INFORMAL SYSTEM IN ALL LEVELS OF THE EDUCATIONAL SYSTEM
rows.abstract: Applies  to all applicants for  a teaching job, as well as the teaching personnel, both  in formal and informal systems in public and private schools. Requires these applicants TO SECURE A LICENSE TO TEACH  FROM THE DECS AFTER COMPLYING WITH PRESCRIBED CONDITIONS; provides   for these concerns: (1) preliminary requirements; (2) procedure for securing license; (3) exemptions; and (4) evaluation.  * * *  4
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 1993-11-04

rows.author: A049
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 23 ARTICLE IV OF THE R.A. 7164 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS AN ACT REGULATING THE PRACTICE OF NURSING IN THE PHILIPPINES (Requires nursing applicants to belong to the upper 30%-40% of the graduating class of the secondary courses)
rows.abstract: Requires applicants to the nursing course to  AT LEAST  BELONG TO THE UPPER THIRTY (30%) to  FORTY PERCENT  (40%) OF THE GRADUATING CLASS  of  the general secondary course.  * * *
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 1993-11-04

rows.author: A069
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 16 OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE 1177 BY ENSURING THAT BASIC EDUCATION GETS THE HIGHEST BUDGETARY PRIORITY
rows.abstract: Declares that: "The Department  of Culture  and Sports (DECS) shall  receive the  highest budgetary priority, fifty percent (50%)  of which  shall be appropriated for  basic education. The  share  of the DECS in the total budget  for the succeedingyears shall not be diminished compared  with the  budget of the previous years and  shall in  fact be increased  in proportion to  the number   of enrollees in basic education." * * *
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 1993-11-04
